title: Nano-NiCo2O4-catalyzed dehydrogenative direct esterification and amidation of primary alcohols under microwave conditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3725-3734
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07245J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kumari Anchal, Keya Roy, Laksmikanta Adak, Subhash Banerjee
Here, we report NiCo2O4 nanoparticle-catalyzed dehydrogenative esterification and amidation of primary alcohols to esters and amides, respectively, in excellent yields under microwave irradiation, without an oxidant.
